conf.description: ArcSight SmartConnectors connector-audit / avro-kafka: the Avro decode itself happens at the Kafka+Schema-Registry Source, so this pipeline starts from already-flat canonical-schema fields; it derives event.outcome from the signature-ID lookup recommendations.direct.cribl specifies verbatim, canonicalizes event.action off deviceEventClassId, resolves the agent:049 deviceCustomString1..6 label-keyed parser slots, and renames the rest to ECS/custom.

conf.comment: arcsight-connectors / connector-audit / avro-kafka. Avro decode happens in the Kafka+Schema-Registry Source, not here - fields arrive flat with canonical schema names, no serde step needed. event.outcome uses the EXACT lookup from recommendations.direct.cribl (authoritative): success={030,016,020,101,025}, failure={015,028,029,042,102,103,104,105,008,011,026}. agent:029 = connector discarded already-collected events; any parity window containing it compares against an incomplete legacy baseline. agent:049's deviceCustomString1..6 are resolved by their paired Label, never by slot position. Order: label resolution -> eval (from ORIGINAL names) -> batched rename.

functions.description: authoritative event.outcome lookup, why no Avro deserializer runs here, and the label-not-slot rule

conf.code: for (var i = 1; i <= 6; i++) { var val = __e['deviceCustomString' + i]; var label = __e['deviceCustomString' + i + 'Label']; if (val === undefined || label === undefined) continue; var l = String(label).toLowerCase(); if (l === 'parser file') { __e['_cs_parser_file'] = val; } else if (l === 'override status') { __e['_cs_override_status'] = val; } else if (l === 'default signature') { __e['_cs_default_signature'] = val; } else if (l === 'override signature') { __e['_cs_override_signature'] = val; } else if (l === 'override parser file') { __e['_cs_override_parser_file'] = val; } else if (l === 'override parser version') { __e['_cs_override_parser_version'] = val; } }

functions.description: resolve agent:049's documented cs1-cs6 Label values into named temp fields; slots on other codes with undocumented label meanings are left unresolved rather than guessed

canonicalize event.action off deviceEventClassId (vendor name text differs connector-side vs Manager-side rendering), the authoritative event.outcome lookup, _time from the Avro deviceReceiptTime, event.kind, event.dataset - all reading ORIGINAL field names before rename

batch rename every clean-named canonical-schema field to its ECS or custom arcsight.connector.* target, including the label-resolved agent:049 parser-slot temp fields; deviceReceiptTime and name are fully consumed by the eval above and left as raw duplicates rather than forced through a rejected rename path; message and deviceCustomString1..6/Label are already correctly named or intentionally left unresolved
